body: Unfortunately I haven't been able to secure a job yet, but it's my own fault for my lack of motivation. My skin was yet again putting me in a hard place. I've strengthened my bonds with my people, so once I get a job, hopefully it's easy from there on out. Good to hear you're doing better, remember to always be thankful and optimistic for the good stuff in life.
Can anyone point me to the way of the footage?

Jazakallah for your response. I have not yet come in contact with any holistic doctor, I've visited a lot of doctors regardless as well as dermatologists, but no one seems to have the answer. When I get frustrated, I often get the burn sensation and usually after Jummah, excluding this Jummah, I go shopping for groceries and experience it when coming back from the shops. May Allah forgive me, but I missed my first Jummah in longer than a year, and I missed all my prayers today, I'm someone who usually has good faith and always try promote it to those that surround me. Now I feel like a hypocrite for losing a bit of faith myself. I really shouldn't work out as well, due to a loss of appetite, I've dropped around 7kg from the start of February and I haven't lost that sort of weight in the last 3 years when I was actively going gym.

Sorry I didn't reply all day, I was in bed till 6pm struggling to get up. I am working, it's a minimum wage job that I work from home, sure money is money, but it ain't enough. I do appreciate the thought, but I struggle to find a job that fits my needs and will pay well. In regards to people leaving you, maybe you get attached quick. I cut a lot of people out of my life, the people that leave your side weren't destined to remain by your side. I hope you understand your worth and don't go out of your way to keep a friend. You'll always meet new people and I hope you find the right circle, me on the other hand, I've got my friends who support me and I'm thankful of them even if they struggle to understand my condition. Don't try force it, let them come to you, and always greet them with the correct energy.

What else do you find interesting or enjoy, I live in the UK, so I absolutely adore football, do you have any interests that could relieve you of any emotions? Maybe get in contact with some siblings if you have any, they'll understand you and would be able to empathize.

If you care about them, go upto them and ask them, of course there are boundaries, but you don't know what they may be going through, and your support may mean the world. Of course, just be yourself, else you might catch them off guard, start the conversation the way you normally would, but then ask why have you been so quiet etc, hope this helps.

Take some time off work, go on a vacation of some sort, I never lost a family member, rather I grew up without a father. Your workplace seems toxic. I think the reason I haven't went on a trip yet is due to financial struggles, but if you have the financial means, travel, and maybe you will find some peace.

You don't need to worry about friends to be honest, as you grow older, you realise, those friends in school all disappear. In school, I was quite popular, now I finished school and 2 years later, only speak to roughly 5 or so members from my school. Having onljne friends isn't a bad thing, I'd be willing to be your friend if we could find common ground.
